title: Ramon Probable NDE 6320
content: It was around 5 pm on that day in October 2004 that I felt very tired. I asked myself ‘why do I feel like this?’ I wasn't doing anything different from the day before. My other self answered me and said, ‘Ramón you need to get some rest.’ When I lay down on the bed I felt as if an elephant was sitting on my chest, then I left my body. There appeared tunnels of light; at no point did I stop thinking or looking. Occasionally, I dodged around black spaces. (I think that when you leave your body you travel at incredible speed; this makes the stars pass by in a blur so I could see tunnels of light.) When I came to a stop, I was facing a person identical to me, though I did not believe that it was me. Instinctively, I went to him and embraced him. After 20 years in the garment business, I noticed he wore a white shirt and pants, and carried a sky-blue bag. I was aware that he was entirely energy. I wanted to see his face, but he no longer had a face. (I have come to understand that the light takes human form in order to assist us, because on arriving there we do not yet realize we are no longer human.) Next I wanted to go through the door of light, and he told me: I could not, I had to go back; so I let myself return for my daughter, Melissa. Before re-entering my body, I stopped in that place, people speak of, where there is peace and tranquility: next to the light which emerges as if from a tunnel. It was there that I thought I was going crazy, as I was surrounded by thousands and thousands of energies (spirits) like myself, all moving towards the place from where I was returning. I went over to the left and came upon another very big group of energies; from these one detached himself and went down on his knees, as if begging forgiveness from me. I did not recognize him, initially, (though later I did). From this immense gathering of energy is born a long line of energies (spirits) going towards and delivering themselves to where the light ended. When I approached this line, I did not like the feeling there. (It was like the feeling of having studied hard for an exam, and then failing it despite all the study.) I looked again at the place where I first arrived, and could still see thousands and thousands of energies appearing and disappearing, going towards the place from where I was returning. I wanted to go on looking because I wanted to understand what that place was. Then I felt myself being called. I entered through my head down as far as my feet. ‘In this life and the next, stay in the light, Ramón.’

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt 'as if an elephant was sitting on my chest', then 'I left my body.'

tunnel.movement_other_detail: He associated leaving the body with 'incredible speed' and stars passing 'by in a blur'; he also 'dodged around black spaces.'

arrival.other_being_detail: A person 'identical to me' who was 'entirely energy' and appeared to function as an assisting presence; later he describes being among 'thousands and thousands of energies (spirits) like myself.'

environment.environment_other_detail: A 'door of light' and being 'next to the light which emerges as if from a tunnel'; also mentions 'black spaces.'

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: He reports being 'called' and re-entering 'through my head down as far as my feet.'
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: 'In this life and the next, stay in the light, Ramón.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Sudden extreme fatigue and chest pressure ('as if an elephant was sitting on my chest') before leaving the body; no diagnosis stated.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Encounter with 'thousands and thousands of energies (spirits)' and a line of spirits moving toward where 'the light ended'; one spirit knelt 'as if begging forgiveness'.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE → tunnels of light/rapid travel with black spaces → encounter with an identical energetic figure → 'door of light' boundary and instruction to return → pause near the light among many spirits → return into body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He describes speaking with 'my other self' before lying down; later he encounters a figure 'identical to me' that he later says may be 'the light' taking human form to assist. He also reports dodging 'black spaces' while traveling at 'incredible speed' with stars blurring by.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “In this life and the next, stay in the light, Ramón.”
